"When this hits, draw a card" is implemented.

"Whenever this FRAGMENTS, you may put a Lightning INSTANT card from your GRAVEYARD on top of your deck" is NOT, and is removed rather than left doing something else. It was SEARCH_DECK with card_type "Instant" unread -- so it searched the DECK, not the graveyard, for ANY card and put it on top: a tutor from the wrong zone with no filter, which is strictly stronger than the printed card and not the same effect. Its trigger was ON_BECOME gated on HAS_KEYWORD "Fragment", which asks whether the card HAS the keyword (it always does) rather than whether it fragmented.

Fragment has no implementation anywhere in the engine -- no trigger, no keyword handler, and the comprehensive rules in docs/ref do not mention it, so it postdates that document. Definition of done: a fragment event exists and this clause comes back, as a graveyard-to-deck-top move (which MOVE_MATCHING already expresses) gated on it.
